name: @aipm/readme-audit
description: Audit a README against open-source best practices and rewrite the sections that close the biggest gaps.
usage: Point this skill at a repo's README (and its actual install/run/test commands) to get a scored gap list and targeted rewrites.
agentDescription: Use this skill when a user wants their README evaluated for open-source readiness or rewritten to close specific gaps. It checks the README against real repo commands (package.json, CI config) rather than trusting the README's own claims, scores it against a fixed checklist (what-it-is, install, quick start, config, contributing, license, support, accuracy), and prioritizes correctness issues over missing sections over polish. It never invents unverifiable details like license or contact info.

examples.title: Audit an existing README
examples.description: Score a README and get a prioritized list of gaps before a public release.
examples.prompt: Audit this repo's README for open-source readiness and tell me what's missing before I make the repo public.

examples.title: Rewrite the install section
examples.description: Close a specific, high-priority gap without a full rewrite.
examples.prompt: Use readme-audit to check whether the install instructions in this README still match package.json, and fix them if not.
